item.title: [The Verge] Elon Musk settles lawsuits over $1 million voter giveaway
item.description: In 2024, Elon Musk promised to give away $1 million a day to a randomly selected registered voter in a swing state. That prompted legal challenges, raised questions about its legality, and drew lawsuits from two Arizona residents claiming the lottery was a fraud. item.title: [The Verge] Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
item.description: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI.
